title: De Futuristen: Hoe kunnen vaders meer zorgen? (in Dutch)
speaker: Mara Yerkes
description: Theatrical talk show in which social scientist Mara Yerkes (UU) and theatre makers explore gender inequality in the family. By Studium Generale and Nieuw Utrechts Toneel, supported by the Descartes Centre. Free; register via TivoliVredenburg.
